title: Overpriced and Flawed
text:
Overpriced and Flawed. Way overpriced, and flawed design. First of all, for the amount they are charging, they should include drywall anchors with the screws. Secondly, for this amount of money we should not have to provide and then apply velcro to keep the shelf from sliding off the two rods. This is unacceptable.

Without the velcro, the shelf is flimsy, loose, and often hard to keep flush against the wall.

Poor design. Poor implementation. Overpriced. I do not recommend this as is.

product_metadata.title: ILoveHandles Plank Floating Cell Phone Wall Mounted Wood Shelf with Magnetic Keyhook - Natural Wood
features: WALL SHELF: This simple design eliminates clutter by holding your phone, wallet and keys all in one place.
KEY ORGANIZER: Holds up to three pairs of heavy keychains by using a powerful magnet without the use of a keyhook.

EASY INSTALL: All hardware is included, and installation is quick and easy. *Please note that the way it is mounted to the way has changed since we made the video. It no longer requires a metal mounting rack.
SMARTPHONE SHELF: Plank comes in two sizes, 5.5 x 3.125 x 0.5 inches and 7 x 4 x 0.5 inches (Plank Plus). Smaller shelf is designed for an iPhone and larger shelf is designed for an iPhone Plus.
DECORATIVE: Made of all natural wood with a simple finish to look sleek and elegant.
description: This simple design features a floating shelf with built in key magnet to store your cell phone and keys in one place. Mount your unit to the wall and organize your belongings. Can hold any size cell phone. Comes in three colors: all natural wood, black walnut and solid black.
